title: Core RDK Entertainment Platform
description: RDK-E is an open, modular and scalable software platform for entertainment devices and streaming ecosystems. It provides a common software foundation for rapid innovation, simplified platform integration, secure content delivery and fleet-scale operations across diverse hardware platforms.
release_overview: RDK9 is under active development, with the release being prepared to build on the Core RDK platform. Its specifications and interfaces are evolving toward an upcoming release for broader ecosystem adoption.

why.title: Why RDK-E?
why.description: RDK-E standardizes core platform functionality while allowing operators, OEMs, and technology partners to focus on creating differentiated user experiences and services. The platform provides a layered architecture that improves portability, maintainability, and time-to-market.
cards: An open, modular platform built from reusable components that can be configured across STB entertainment platforms.
Common APIs and services that help applications work consistently across diverse device platforms.
Layered abstractions that reduce hardware coupling and simplify integration across SoCs and vendor platforms.
Reusable platform capabilities that help operators, OEMs, and technology partners focus on differentiated experiences.

architecture.title: Everything in the Core RDK platform
cards: The evolving set of Core RDK middleware components that provide shared platform functionality.
Application-facing interfaces that give web and native apps consistent access to platform capabilities.
Hardware abstraction interfaces that connect middleware with vendor implementations and platform hardware.
Reference hardware requirements and platform details supporting the upcoming RDK9 release.
